# Master Artist

> Master Artist is a creative workshop studio in Desa Sri Hartamas, Kuala Lumpur. We run painting (sip and paint / paint night), Bake Lab baking, candle making and chunky crochet workshops, plus team days, birthday parties, gift vouchers and weekly art classes. Materials are included, beginners are welcome, and you book your seat on WhatsApp.

Prices below are the ones shown on masterartist.co. Dates and the price of each dated session are always on the workshops page, which is the source of truth.

## Workshops

One-off sessions, usually two hours, taught step by step by working artists. A new theme most weeks. Materials and a drink are included, and you take your piece home the same day. Each session runs with a minimum of 6 people. These are Launch Season prices, until 30 April 2027. Special-theme sessions can be priced differently, so check the date page before you book.

- [All workshops and dates](https://masterartist.co/workshops/): every upcoming session, with times and prices.
- [Textured & Impasto Canvas](https://masterartist.co/workshops/textured-canvas/): a paint night, one canvas built up with texture paste or thick impasto paint. RM89 a person.
- [Acrylic Canvas](https://masterartist.co/workshops/acrylic-canvas/): one brush-on acrylic canvas, 30x40cm. RM89 a person.
- [Watercolour](https://masterartist.co/workshops/watercolour-botanicals/): one watercolour painting on cotton paper. RM80 a person.
- [Glow-in-the-Dark Canvas](https://masterartist.co/workshops/glow-canvas/): a canvas painted with glow-in-the-dark acrylics. RM85 a person.
- [Bake Lab](https://masterartist.co/workshops/bake-lab/): one bake, boxed to take home, in the L1 kitchen. RM95 a person for the usual bread; specialty bakes are RM85.
- [Candle Making](https://masterartist.co/workshops/candle-making/): pour, scent and decorate your own candles in gift-ready jars. RM89 a person.
- [Chunky Crochet](https://masterartist.co/workshops/crochet-bag/): learn the basic stitches with chunky yarn and leave with your own small bag. RM95 a person.
- [This Sunday](https://masterartist.co/this-sunday/): what is on this Sunday, with seats left.
- [Prices](https://masterartist.co/prices/): every price in one place.

## Team days

Art, baking or mixed team days at the studio, with up to 4 rooms running side by side. A drink and all materials are included, and everyone takes something home. See [Team building activities in KL](https://masterartist.co/groups/).

- Art team day: RM1,200 for up to 10 people. Extra person RM100.
- Baking team day: RM1,700 for up to 15 people. Extra person RM100.
- Mixed team day (two or three streams in parallel): RM2,400 for up to 20 people. Extra person RM100.
- Team dinner + evening workshop: RM150 a person, from 10 people.

## Birthday parties

Painting, air-dry clay or baking parties with a teacher, all materials, time for cake (bring your own) and everything boxed to take home. A RM200 deposit holds the date and comes off the total. See [Birthday parties in KL](https://masterartist.co/birthdays/).

- Kids Art Party: RM890 for 10 children, extra child RM69, up to 12. Ages 5–12, 2 hours. Painting a canvas or making an air-dry clay piece.
- Kids Bake Party: RM990 for 10 children, extra child RM79, up to 12. Ages 6–12, 2h30. Mini pizzas or cinnamon rolls.
- Teen & Adult Canvas Birthday: RM89 a person, 8 to 18 people. Ages 13+, 2h30.

## Gift vouchers

A RM100 or RM200 voucher, or a seat at a chosen workshop (painting, candle making, crochet or baking). The recipient picks a date on the workshops page and books on WhatsApp, quoting the voucher. See [Gift vouchers](https://masterartist.co/gift-vouchers/).

## Weekly classes

Ongoing weekly classes in small groups with the same teacher every week, separate from the one-off workshops above. See [Classes](https://masterartist.co/classes/).

- [Kids Art (ages 5–9)](https://masterartist.co/classes/kids-art-younger/): RM320 a month.
- [Kids Art (ages 10–15)](https://masterartist.co/classes/kids-art-older/): RM320 a month.
- [Adult Art](https://masterartist.co/classes/adult-art/): RM320 a month.
- [RM50 trial class](https://masterartist.co/trial/): one weekly art class with the teacher you would have every week. If you continue, the RM50 is credited in full against the first month.
- Siblings get 10% off. Music and voice lessons are one to one; see the [classes page](https://masterartist.co/classes/).

## Book and visit

- Booking: WhatsApp [+60 10-277 9426](https://wa.me/60102779426). Seats are prepaid; we confirm your booking and send payment details on WhatsApp.
- Email: info@masterartist.co
- Address: 38-2, Jalan 28/70A, Desa Sri Hartamas, 50480 Kuala Lumpur (upstairs, above Savor). [Google Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place/?q=place_id:ChIJ_5QUWwBJzDERfwTpMdDHLPY)
- Opening hours: Sunday 10am–6pm; Monday to Thursday 10am–10pm; Friday 10am–5pm; Saturday closed. No workshops after 12:30pm on Fridays and none before 12pm on Sundays.
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/masterartist_co/
